conventions: Money is a string with two decimals. gross and net are as on the document. amount_to_pay is what the run pays if the line is released (0.00 when excluded). variance_net is invoice net minus PO net, in the PO currency (positive: invoice above the PO). dec: PAY schedule; HOLD keep on the run, do not schedule (amount_to_pay is what a later release would pay); EXCL not in the run. appr: NA, REQ (open), OK, NO. One decision per document: a superseded or duplicate document is EXCL and its live version carries the payment. Keys that do not apply are omitted.
